findings.evidence: grep `BalancedTensorProduct.map LinearMap.id` finds 218 and 227. Lines 333-334 of `coefficientMap_differential` pass the same arguments `LinearMap.id ((Finsupp.linearCombination A ν.ν).restrictScalars R) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (fun a g ↦ by simp only [...])` to `differential_naturality`.
findings.fix: Define the tensored row-substitution map once, for example as a `def tensorMap`, state the three results in terms of it, and add one `tensorMap_tmul` lemma.
findings.issue: The term `BalancedTensorProduct.map LinearMap.id ((Finsupp.linearCombination A ν.ν).restrictScalars R) (fun _ _ ↦ rfl) (fun a f ↦ by simp only [...])` and its side-condition proofs are written out three times: in `coefficientMap` (218), `coefficientMap_finsuppScalarRight` (227) and `coefficientMap_differential` (333).

findings.evidence: grep finds `Coefficients.lean:141` (`have he : Finsupp.single x α = finsuppScalarRight R A M P (tmul R A α (Finsupp.single x 1))`). The diff has identical `have hsingle` blocks in `coefficientMap_single` and `coefficientMap_comp`.
findings.fix: Add a `@[simp]`-free lemma such as `single_eq_finsuppScalarRight_tmul` to `Coefficients.lean` and use it at all three sites.
findings.issue: The identity `hsingle : Finsupp.single x α = finsuppScalarRight R A M P (tmul R A α (Finsupp.single x 1))` is proved inline here and again at line 278. It is also proved a third time in `RowFinite/Coefficients.lean:141` (`he`).

findings.evidence: After `rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hd]`, the left side has a `Finset.sum` over the support and the right side is `(ν x).sum (fun y a ↦ ...)`. Nothing rewrites between them; `rfl` bridges them by unfolding.
findings.fix: Rewrite with `Finsupp.sum` explicitly, for example `rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hd, Finsupp.sum]`, or close the goal with `simp [Finsupp.sum]` instead of `rfl`.
findings.issue: The helper `hD` in `continuation_iff` ends with `rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, hd]; rfl`. That `rfl` only closes the goal because `(ν x).sum` unfolds to a `∑` over `(ν x).support`, which is undocumented definitional equality.

summary: The proofs are mostly robust, but one tensor-map term and one single-vector identity are each repeated instead of factored into a lemma, and the helper `hD` in `continuation_iff` ends with an undocumented `rfl` that depends on how `Finsupp.sum` unfolds.
